question.text: Per the chapter, the independent valuer appointed by the investment manager of a Category III AIF must have at least how many years of experience in valuation of unlisted securities?

explanation.text: The Logic: Quoted: 'The independent valuer shall have at least 3 years of experience in valuation of unlisted securities.' The Trap: 1/2/5 are distractors. The regulatory minimum is 3 years. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C tests the same eligibility list. Manager's Pro-Tip: For niche Cat III strategies (distressed credit, structured equity), seek valuers with sector-specific experience beyond the 3-year minimum - SEBI inspections focus on sufficiency of the valuer's skill, not just minimum tenure.
